data.long_meaning: A name derived from various languages, Shah means 'King', 'Ruler', or 'Leader'. It is a name that signifies power, authority, and dominance. In Hindu mythology, the god Indra is also known as Shah, the king of heaven. The name Shah carries the meaning “King, Ruler, Leader” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Shah usually hope their child will grow to embody king, ruler, leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.
